desc: Compact storefront offering a wide range of new & secondhand English-language books.
addr: Ranga Shankara, Post Office, 36/2, 8th Cross Rd, near JP Nagar, R K Colony, 2nd Phase, J. P. Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560078, India

rev.t: This place doesn't have lot of collection. And they have only kanna used books for reselling. I thought I was going to a huge book shop with used books. Disappointed. But next to it they have a drama theatre happening. And a cafe. Affordable.

My first time staying in Bangalore while exploring the neighborhood I was searching for place to buy milk but instead I found this bookstore I was ecstatic and quite enjoying the store to browse books and just the environment is peaceful. They even have used book section with a cheaper prices.
Loved this cute little book store in rangshankara. They had a lovely fiction collection of authors I love and the books I've read and would love to read. It just felt like my goodreads collection 😄 …
